sentences.quote:
Born in Sao Paulo, Brazil, in September 1972.
Mr. Christian Gebara is the CEO of Vivo (Telefonica Brasil) and a member of the Telefonica Group Executive Committee. He has served on the Board of Directors of Vivo since January 2019.
sentences.text: Christian Mauad Gebara, born in Sao Paulo in September 1972, is chief executive officer of Vivo (Telefonica Brasil) and a member of the Telefonica Group Executive Committee, having also served on the company's board of directors since January 2019.

sentences.quote: He became COO of Vivo in February 2017, responsible for all business and operating areas. Prior to this, he served as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) from July 2015. He joined Telefonica in June 2006 as Director of Quality and Processes at Telefonica Espana, and following the integration of Telefonica Vivo in 2011, held successive Vice President roles in Strategy, New Businesses, and Mobile Business.
sentences.text: He joined Telefonica in June 2006 as director of quality and processes at Telefonica Espana, held vice president roles in strategy, new businesses and mobile business after the 2011 integration of Telefonica and Vivo, became chief revenue officer in July 2015 and chief operating officer in February 2017, with responsibility for all business and operating areas.

sentences.quote: Prior to joining Telefonica, he held positions at McKinsey & Company, JP Morgan Chase, Banco ABC Roma, and Citibank.
sentences.text: Earlier in his career he worked at McKinsey & Company, JP Morgan Chase, Banco ABC and Citibank.

sentences.quote: Mr. Christian Gebara holds a degree in Business Administration from Fundacao Getulio Vargas - Sao Paulo and an MBA from the Graduate School of Business, Stanford University.
sentences.text: He holds a business administration degree from Fundacao Getulio Vargas in Sao Paulo and an MBA from Stanford University's Graduate School of Business.

mgmt_bio.text: Christian Mauad Gebara, born in Sao Paulo in September 1972, is chief executive officer of Vivo (Telefonica Brasil) and a member of the Telefonica Group Executive Committee, having also served on the company's board of directors since January 2019. He joined Telefonica in June 2006 as director of quality and processes at Telefonica Espana, held vice president roles in strategy, new businesses and mobile business after the 2011 integration of Telefonica and Vivo, became chief revenue officer in July 2015 and chief operating officer in February 2017, with responsibility for all business and operating areas. Earlier in his career he worked at McKinsey & Company, JP Morgan Chase, Banco ABC and Citibank. He holds a business administration degree from Fundacao Getulio Vargas in Sao Paulo and an MBA from Stanford University's Graduate School of Business.
